theme.style: A dark supercell world: near-black storm navy and slate charcoal skies broken by electric cyan pressure light and hot amber-warning glow. Lighting is dramatic and volumetric, like lightning flashing behind deep cloud decks, with soft atmospheric haze, fine rain-grain texture and glassy instrument-panel reflections. Backgrounds stay moody and calm in the upper third so headlines read like warning text on a radar console.
